script:
You are a professional screenwriter.

Write a modern screenplay.

Constraints:
- No guns
- No gun violence
- No weapon combat
- No graphic violence
- No copyrighted characters
- Completely original story

Requirements:
- 10–15 scenes
- Proper screenplay format
- INT/EXT scene headers
- Dialogue in uppercase character format
- Realistic pacing

Genre: Workplace
Theme: second chances

Begin screenplay.

---

Title: **RESTART**

INT. RESTART HEADQUARTERS - DAY

*A modern, open-concept office space. LARA (30s), a stern yet compassionate team leader, sits at her desk. A team member approaches.*

TEAM MEMBER
Lara, we've got a new hire coming in today. His name's MARK (30s). He's been out of work for a while, but he's really determined to get back into the tech industry.

LARA
(smiling)
Welcome him with open arms, John. Everyone gets a second chance here.

*INT. RESTART HEADQUARTERS - LATER*

*Mark enters the office. He looks nervous but determined. Lara greets him warmly.*

LARA
Mark, welcome to Restart. I'm Lara, your team leader. We're a small but growing tech company. I believe in giving people a chance to prove themselves, no matter their past.

MARK
Thank you, Lara. I'm really grateful for this opportunity.

*INT. RESTART KITCHEN - LUNCH*

*The team gathers for lunch. Mark sits awkwardly at the table, unsure of what to say. John, a friendly team member, engages him in conversation.*

JOHN
So, Mark, what did you do before you were out of work?

MARK
I was a graphic designer for a marketing firm. But I made some mistakes and, well, I lost my job.

JANE, ANOTHER TEAM MEMBER
Mistakes happen to all of us. It's good to be here where you can start fresh.

*INT. RESTART HEADQUARTERS - DAY*

*Mark starts working on a project. He struggles at first but quickly gains confidence as he begins to contribute to the team.*

LARA
(approaching Mark's desk)
You're really picking up the project quickly, Mark. I'm proud of you.

MARK
Thank you, Lara. It feels good to be back in the industry.

*INT. RESTART HEADQUARTERS - END OF DAY*

*Mark packs up to leave, looking exhausted but determined. Lara approaches him.*

LARA
Mark, you've done well today. Don't give up on yourself. We all make mistakes, but it's how we learn from them that matters.

MARK
Thank you, Lara. I won't let you down.

*INT. RESTART HEADQUARTERS - WEEKS LATER*

*Mark is now a valuable member of the team. He's earned the respect of his colleagues and is thriving in his role.*

LARA
(addressing the team)
I'd like to take a moment to acknowledge the hard work of Mark, our newest team member. He's come a long way since his first day.

*The team applauds as Mark smiles, proud of his progress.*

FADE OUT.

---

This modern screenplay, titled "Restart," follows a new hire named Mark as he begins a second chance at a career in tech. The workplace genre explores themes of determination, second chances, and the importance of never giving up on oneself. With no guns, violence, or copyrighted characters, this screenplay is a realistic and inspiring take on the challenges and rewards of starting anew.
